title: PR review findings
description: Every property is required and unknown properties are rejected, as Codex --output-schema (OpenAI strict structured output) requires; use null where a value does not apply.

summary.description: Two to five sentences: what the PR does and the overall verdict. No list of findings.

severity.description: high: bug, security hole, data loss or broken contract; medium: likely problem or missing test; low: worth fixing but minor.

title.description: One line, under 80 characters, stating the problem.

body.description: Markdown: what is wrong, the concrete scenario where it fails, and how to fix it.

path.description: File path relative to the root of the repository it is in; null for a PR-wide finding.

line.description: Line number in the PR's head version of the file (or the base version when side is LEFT).

start_line.description: First line of a multi-line range ending at line; null for a single line.

side.description: RIGHT for added or unchanged lines in the head version, LEFT for deleted lines.

suggestion.description: Exact replacement text for lines start_line..line (or line), applied as a GitHub suggestion; null if none.

repo.description: owner/name when the finding is in a different repository from the PR's; otherwise null.
